resolution.note: No git hook exists (core.hooksPath unset, .git/hooks holds only samples, git hook list empty for all events); a plain commit in a fresh worktree exits 0 and runs no hook, so the PR #356 bypass skipped nothing and nothing misfired. lanes.md now forbids bypass. A bypass leaves no trace in a commit; CI re-running lint, typecheck and all tests on the exact head (pinned by test/workflow.test.ts) makes it gain nothing.

title: Refuse git hook bypass in lane commits
body:
Outcome: lane commits run the repository git hooks; a bypass is visible and refused.
Evidence: lane for t-mgj0693 (PR #356) committed with `git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null` and reported it; CI stayed green, but hooks are skipped silently by design.
Acceptance: first find which hook made the lane bypass it (reproduce a commit in a worktree) and fix that hook if it misfires in worktrees; then `.agents/skills/krn-lead/lanes.md` forbids hook bypass and a check (rule test or CI step) detects it where possible.
